figures.shows: One frame of 16.7 ms on a time line: the queue and the input, a wait of 6.0 ms for the display, the layers, the modules and the user interface, then 1.2 ms of presenting, with the work blocks bracketed
figures.caption: Only the blue blocks count as the frame's work; the striped waits do not.
figures.alt: A time line of one frame. Short blue blocks stand at the start, then a long striped wait, three more blue blocks, and a short striped block for presenting. Brackets above the blue blocks mark the work.
